Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 142. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 10x ki per blast
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 120 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: 1 Minute (concentration)
Type: barrage
Select a number of unoccupied 5 foot squares up to
but not exceeding double your wisdom modifier to leave
a Ki Blast. You may choose to detonate these at any
time at no cost or action causing anyone within 5 feet to
make a dexterity saving throw dealing 2d8 Ki damage
on a fail and half as much on a success.
As an action on your turn your may cause any number
of these to fly at a target of your choice within range.
Make a ranged ki attack using your barrage bonus for
each dealing 2d8 Ki damage on a hit per ki blast.
